name: Sunlit Vale Expansion
author: Jianjun99
blurb: Three new dungeons for the Sunlit Vale: the sewers beneath Oakhaven, an abandoned mill on the outskirts, and the Sun Dragon's Roost in the volcanic peaks. Levels 3-12.
